fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: Your passport must have an expiry date at least 6 months after the date of your visa application.
entry.es: Tu pasaporte debe tener una fecha de vencimiento al menos 6 meses posterior a la fecha de tu solicitud de visa.
entry.quote: your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date of your visa application

entry.en: You must have a certificate proving a yellow fever vaccination to enter Sierra Leone.
entry.es: Debes tener un certificado que acredite la vacunación contra la fiebre amarilla para entrar a Sierra Leona.
entry.quote: you must have a certificate to prove you’ve had a yellow fever vaccination

entry.en: All travellers entering or leaving Sierra Leone must complete a health declaration online before travel using the Sierra Leone Health Travel Portal.
entry.es: Todos los viajeros que entren o salgan de Sierra Leona deben completar antes del viaje una declaración de salud en línea en el portal Sierra Leone Health Travel Portal.
entry.quote: All travellers entering or leaving Sierra Leone must complete a health declaration before travel using the Sierra Leone Health Travel Portal.

entry.en: The health declaration form must be completed online within 72 hours before travel.
entry.es: El formulario de declaración de salud debe completarse en línea dentro de las 72 horas previas al viaje.
entry.quote: complete the form online within 72 hours before travel

entry.en: You must have an export licence to leave Sierra Leone with precious stones.
entry.es: Debes tener una licencia de exportación para salir de Sierra Leona con piedras preciosas.
entry.quote: You must have an export licence to leave Sierra Leone with precious stones.

entry.en: An airport security fee of $25 must be paid on arrival and departure, online via Securipass or in cash at bank desks in the arrivals hall.
entry.es: Se debe pagar una tasa de seguridad aeroportuaria de 25 dólares a la llegada y a la salida, en línea por Securipass o en efectivo en las ventanillas bancarias del vestíbulo de llegadas.
entry.quote: An airport security fee of $25 needs to be paid on arrival and departure.  This should be paid online using the Securipass web site or in cash at one of the bank desks in the arrivals hall.

safety.en: Crime rates in Sierra Leone are comparatively low, but incidents of violent and organised crime are rising.
safety.es: Las tasas de criminalidad en Sierra Leona son comparativamente bajas, pero los incidentes de crimen violento y organizado van en aumento.
safety.quote: Crime rates in Sierra Leone are comparatively low, however incidents of violent and organised crime are rising.

safety.en: The greatest risk to short-stay visitors is from pickpocketing and mugging in Freetown.
safety.es: El mayor riesgo para los visitantes de corta estancia son los carteristas y los atracos en Freetown.
safety.quote: The greatest risk to short-stay visitors is from pickpocketing and mugging in Freetown.

safety.en: Public transport drivers and passengers have robbed foreign visitors, so FCDO advises avoiding taxis, poda-podas, kekes and ocadas.
safety.es: Conductores y pasajeros del transporte público han robado a visitantes extranjeros, por lo que el FCDO aconseja evitar taxis, poda-podas, kekes y ocadas.
safety.quote: Public transport drivers and passengers have robbed foreign visitors. Avoid travelling in taxis, minibuses (‘poda-podas’), motorised rickshaws (‘kekes’) or motorbikes (‘ocadas’).

safety.en: Same-sex relations between men are illegal in Sierra Leone, even if consensual, and penalties can include imprisonment.
safety.es: Las relaciones entre hombres del mismo sexo son ilegales en Sierra Leona, incluso si son consentidas, y las penas pueden incluir la cárcel.
safety.quote: Same-sex relations between men are illegal in Sierra Leone, even if they are consensual. Penalties can include imprisonment.

safety.en: There are strong ocean currents along the coast and no lifeguards on any beaches.
safety.es: Hay fuertes corrientes oceánicas a lo largo de la costa y no hay socorristas en ninguna playa.
safety.quote: There are strong ocean currents along the coast in Sierra Leone, and no lifeguards on any beaches.

safety.en: Do not take pictures of military installations or official government buildings, including prisons and courthouses, as people have been arrested for doing so.
safety.es: No fotografíes instalaciones militares ni edificios oficiales del gobierno, incluidas cárceles y juzgados, ya que ha habido personas detenidas por hacerlo.
safety.quote: Do not take pictures of military installations or any other official government buildings, including prisons and courthouses. There have been instances where individuals have been arrested for doing so.

health.en: Water-borne diseases, including cholera, are endemic, so you should drink or use only boiled or bottled water and avoid ice in drinks.
health.es: Las enfermedades transmitidas por el agua, incluido el cólera, son endémicas, por lo que debes beber o usar solo agua hervida o embotellada y evitar el hielo en las bebidas.
health.quote: You should drink or use only boiled or bottled water and avoid ice in drinks.

health.en: Hospitals and medical facilities are severely limited, and many facilities outside Freetown only accept cash payments.
health.es: Los hospitales y servicios médicos son muy limitados, y muchos centros fuera de Freetown solo aceptan pagos en efectivo.
health.quote: Many facilities, particularly outside of Freetown, only accept cash payments.

health.en: Ambulance services are unreliable in Freetown and unavailable throughout most of the country.
health.es: Los servicios de ambulancia no son fiables en Freetown y no están disponibles en la mayor parte del país.
health.quote: Ambulance services are unreliable in Freetown and unavailable throughout most of the country.

health.en: You should have adequate travel health insurance and accessible funds to cover medical treatment, evacuation and repatriation.
health.es: Debes tener un seguro médico de viaje adecuado y fondos accesibles para cubrir tratamiento médico, evacuación y repatriación.
health.quote: Make sure you have adequate travel health insurance and accessible funds to cover the cost of any medical treatment abroad, medical evacuation and repatriation.

health.en: Wikivoyage says malaria is the biggest danger and visitors without anti-malarials and possibly a mosquito net are risking their life.
health.es: Wikivoyage dice que la malaria es el mayor peligro y que quien viaje sin antipalúdicos y posiblemente mosquitero arriesga su vida.
health.quote: Malaria is, as usual, the biggest danger, and any foreign visitor travelling without anti-malarials and possibly a mosquito net is risking their life.

health.en: Lassa fever can be contracted in Kenema and the east.
health.es: La fiebre de Lassa puede contraerse en Kenema y el este.
health.quote: Lassa fever can be contracted in Kenema and the east.

help.en: The emergency number for ambulance, fire and police is 117.
help.es: El número de emergencias para ambulancia, bomberos y policía es el 117.

help.en: You should call 117 and ask for an ambulance.
help.es: Debes llamar al 117 y pedir una ambulancia.
help.quote: Call 117 and ask for an ambulance.

help.en: Wikivoyage says Sierra Leone uses 112 for emergency calls from any phone network, and the calls are free.
help.es: Wikivoyage dice que Sierra Leona usa el 112 para llamadas de emergencia desde cualquier red, y son gratuitas.
help.quote: Sierra Leone uses 112 for emergency calls from any phone network.  Calls are free and will be directed to the relevant emergency service.

getting_in.en: The international airport is at Lungi, on the other side of the estuary from Freetown.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto internacional está en Lungi, al otro lado del estuario respecto a Freetown.
getting_in.quote: The international airport is at Lungi, the other side of the estuary from Freetown.

getting_in.en: Most people use water taxis to get to Freetown, run by Sea Coach Express and Sea Bird Express, charging around US$50 for a single adult journey.
getting_in.es: La mayoría usa taxis acuáticos para llegar a Freetown, operados por Sea Coach Express y Sea Bird Express, y cobran unos 50 dólares por trayecto de adulto.
getting_in.quote: Most people choose to use the water taxi services to get to Freetown.  There are 2 main companies - Sea Coach Express (Pelican) which goes to Aberdeen Bridge and Sea Bird Express going to Murray Town.  Both charge around US$50 for a single adult journey.

getting_in.en: Car ferries from Tagrin at Lungi dock at Kissy Ferry Terminal and cross in 45-70 minutes, but can take several hours including waiting and loading.
getting_in.es: Los ferris de coches desde Tagrin, en Lungi, atracan en la terminal de Kissy y cruzan en 45-70 minutos, pero pueden tardar varias horas con la espera y la carga.
getting_in.quote: which cross the water in 45-70 minutes, but can take several hours including waiting/loading times

getting_in.en: Sierra Leone can be accessed by road from Guinea (Conakry) and Liberia.
getting_in.es: Se puede llegar a Sierra Leona por carretera desde Guinea (Conakry) y Liberia.
getting_in.quote: Sierra Leone can be accessed by road from Guinea (Conakry) and Liberia.

getting_in.en: Wikivoyage says it can be very difficult to find flight seats in December because of locals returning for Christmas, so booking early is essential.
getting_in.es: Wikivoyage dice que puede ser muy difícil encontrar asientos en diciembre porque los locales regresan por Navidad, por lo que reservar con antelación es esencial.
getting_in.quote: It can be very difficult finding seats in December because of local people returning for the Christmas holidays. Booking early is essential.

getting_in.en: FCDO says the journey from Freetown to Lungi airport is around 3 hours by road and there are no car hire facilities at the airport.
getting_in.es: El FCDO indica que el trayecto por carretera entre Freetown y el aeropuerto de Lungi es de unas 3 horas y que no hay alquiler de coches en el aeropuerto.
getting_in.quote: The journey time from Freetown to the airport is around 3 hours by road. There are no car hire facilities at the airport.

getting_around.en: Poda-podas are cheap, with intercity trips often costing Le1,500-2,500 and any trip within Freetown just Le1,000.
getting_around.es: Los poda-podas son baratos: los viajes interurbanos suelen costar Le1.500-2.500 y cualquier trayecto dentro de Freetown solo Le1.000.
getting_around.quote: Intercity trips often cost Le1,500-2,500 (in 2017, less than US$0.50), and any trip within Freetown just Le1,000.

getting_around.en: Poda-podas have no designated bus stops, and petty theft is common on these buses, which are usually dangerously overloaded.
getting_around.es: Los poda-podas no tienen paradas designadas, el hurto menor es común en ellos y suelen ir peligrosamente sobrecargados.
getting_around.quote: There are no designated bus stops and so one can stand on a street and wave to get it to stop. However, be careful with personal belongings as petty theft is common on these buses.

getting_around.en: The main roads to regional cities such as Bo, Kenema and Makeni are in excellent condition.
getting_around.es: Las carreteras principales hacia ciudades regionales como Bo, Kenema y Makeni están en excelente estado.
getting_around.quote: the main roads to regional cities such as Bo, Kenema and Makeni are in excellent condition

getting_around.en: Moto-taxis are efficient and cheap but dangerous, and it is against the law to have more than two people on one motorcycle.
getting_around.es: Los mototaxis son eficientes y baratos pero peligrosos, y es ilegal llevar a más de dos personas en una moto.
getting_around.quote: It's also against the law nowadays to have more than two people on one motorcycle.

getting_around.en: The police use wheel clamps in Freetown, and street parking on major routes such as Wilkinson Road is not permitted.
getting_around.es: La policía usa cepos en Freetown y no se permite estacionar en la calle en vías principales como Wilkinson Road.
getting_around.quote: Street parking on major routes such as Wilkinson Road is not permitted.

getting_around.en: FCDO advises trying to complete road travel during daylight hours as risks are higher at night.
getting_around.es: El FCDO aconseja intentar completar los viajes por carretera durante el día, ya que los riesgos son mayores de noche.
getting_around.quote: try to complete your travel during daylight hours as risks are higher at night

money.en: The unit of currency is the Leone, denoted by the symbol Le (ISO code SLE).
money.es: La unidad monetaria es el leone, con el símbolo Le (código ISO SLE).
money.quote: The unit of currency is the Leone, denoted by the symbol "Le" (ISO currency code: SLE).

money.en: Old Leone notes ceased to be legal tender on 1 January 2024 and can now only be changed at the central bank.
money.es: Los billetes antiguos de leone dejaron de ser de curso legal el 1 de enero de 2024 y ahora solo se pueden cambiar en el banco central.
money.quote: The old notes ceased to be legal tender on 1 January 2024.  Old Leone notes can only be changed at the central bank now.

money.en: Credit and debit cards are accepted in an increasing number of supermarkets, restaurants and hotels, mostly Visa.
money.es: Las tarjetas de crédito y débito se aceptan en un número creciente de supermercados, restaurantes y hoteles, sobre todo Visa.
money.quote: Credit/debit cards are accepted in an increasing number of supermarkets, restaurants and hotels (Visa mostly).

money.en: There are ATMs in Freetown and other bigger towns.
money.es: Hay cajeros automáticos en Freetown y otras ciudades más grandes.
money.quote: There are ATMs in Freetown and other bigger towns.

money.en: Foreigners usually pay considerably more than locals for goods on the street, so Wikivoyage advises bargaining.
money.es: Los extranjeros suelen pagar bastante más que los locales por productos en la calle, por lo que Wikivoyage aconseja regatear.
money.quote: Foreigners usually pay considerably more than the price quoted to locals when it comes to goods you find on the street so make sure to bargain and lower the price as much as you can.

money.en: Wikivoyage says high import duties plus 15% Goods and Services Tax mean many goods cost double what you would expect elsewhere.
money.es: Wikivoyage dice que los altos aranceles más un impuesto del 15% sobre bienes y servicios hacen que muchos productos cuesten el doble de lo esperado en otros países.
money.quote: The lack of a good import system and high import duties plus 15% Goods and Services Tax (GST) mean that many goods are double the price that one would expect to pay in other countries.

etiquette.en: Sierra Leone has a tolerant, multi-religion culture, and you should respect local traditions, customs, laws and religions.
etiquette.es: Sierra Leona tiene una cultura tolerante y multirreligiosa, y debes respetar las tradiciones, costumbres, leyes y religiones locales.
etiquette.quote: Sierra Leone has a tolerant, multi-religion culture. Always respect local traditions, customs, laws and religions and make sure your actions do not cause offence.

connectivity.en: Mobile phone networks use GSM/3G/4G technology as in Europe, and use is widespread.
connectivity.es: Las redes móviles usan tecnología GSM/3G/4G como en Europa y su uso está extendido.
connectivity.quote: The mobile phone networks use GSM/3G/4G technology (as in Europe) and use is widespread.

connectivity.en: Orange, Qcell and Africell offer 2G/3G/4G services which work very well.
connectivity.es: Orange, Qcell y Africell ofrecen servicios 2G/3G/4G que funcionan muy bien.
connectivity.quote: Orange, Qcell and Africell offer 2G/3G/4G services which work very well.

connectivity.en: Video calling using apps like WhatsApp works well in all towns.
connectivity.es: Las videollamadas con aplicaciones como WhatsApp funcionan bien en todas las ciudades.
connectivity.quote: Video calling using apps like WhatsApp work well in all towns.

connectivity.en: FCDO says there is no country-wide mobile coverage and some areas have no mobile reception.
connectivity.es: El FCDO indica que no hay cobertura móvil en todo el país y que algunas zonas no tienen señal.
connectivity.quote: There is no country-wide coverage from mobile network providers in Sierra Leone. Some areas have no mobile reception.

connectivity.en: Mains power is unreliable and extended outages are common.
connectivity.es: La red eléctrica no es fiable y los cortes prolongados son comunes.
connectivity.quote: Mains power is unreliable and extended outages are common.
